verdict.rationale: Proa components are typed Rust (proa-docs-7, proa-docs-15) and use a template macro that is validated at compile time with escaped dynamic slots (proa-gh-2). Signals and event handlers sit in the same component (proa-gh-3), and editor tooling covers Rust inside the templates (proa-docs-26), so markup and rendering logic live together in a language Rust developers already know. missing for 10: evidence that styles are co-located within the component (only separate stylesheet hot-reload and theming are mentioned), a concrete documented example of a component's markup syntax, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
